name: PixelDaydream
author: Jenna Studio
description: A dreamy y2k / kawaii pastel theme for KakaoTalk on iOS: pink -> lavender -> baby-blue gradients, pixel butterflies, hearts and sparkles, checkered pixel borders, and retro 'chat window' bubbles (pink received, periwinkle sent).

fonts.note: KakaoTalk renders in-app text in the system font; the .ktheme format has no font property, so the theme cannot replace the chat or passcode-keypad font. The pixel-styled numbers/letters in the reference art are decorative only; the theme controls keypad text color, not glyph shape.

note: This manifest is source metadata only. A KakaoTalk .ktheme package contains KakaoTalkTheme.css + Images/ at the archive root; manifest.json is not included in the package.
